title: oxalis floribunda subsp. ostenii
intro: Oxalis floribunda subsp. ostenii, commonly known as the Osten's wood sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oxalidaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and act as a natural diuretic. Oxalis floribunda subsp. ostenii contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
